source_item.brief: Three cases recorded signal validation failures (financing_listing_action:v5, guidance_acceleration:v3, order_confirmation_disclosed:v2) that removed forward-expectations and order-confirmation evidence from the research pass, yet all three cases were still scored and none was a technical exclusion.
source_item.detail: The trajectory table records recorded_signal_execution_failures for case_index 3 (financing_listing_action:v5, validation_failed), case_index 22 (guidance_acceleration:v3, validation_failed), and case_index 23 (order_confirmation_disclosed:v2, validation_failed). The technical_completion statistics for plan_r0001_c01 report technical_exclusion_count = 0, technical_completion_rate = 1.0, and scoring_effect_counts with 0 technical negative abstentions, so these validation failures did not remove the cases from the scored denominator. Case 22 and 23 were magnitude underestimates (2-3x predicted, 3-10x realized); case 3 was a binary false positive. The validation failures are technical execution gaps in the evidence pipeline, not evidence that the measured conditions were absent, and they should be repaired separately from research-quality changes.
limitations: A validation failure does not prove the measured condition was absent or negative; it only means no validated domain result was produced.
The trajectory table is a bounded view; the full signal execution records are preserved separately.
The realized outcomes do not establish that the missing signals would have changed the magnitude band.

scope.conditions: Index when diagnosing whether missing forward-guidance or order-confirmation evidence contributed to magnitude underestimates in plan_r0001_c01; use to route repair to the signal validation layer rather than to the research prompt.
